records.issue_text: app/jobs/scheduled/poll_feed.rb:30 and app/models/topic_embed.rb:15 — RSS i.content is stored as raw_html without sanitization, allowing malicious feed HTML such as scripts or event handlers to execute when imported topics are viewed.
records.rationale: The diff confirms the mechanism: PollFeed passes CGI.unescapeHTML(i.content) to TopicEmbed.import, which uses PostCreator with cook_method: Post.cook_methods[:raw_html]; Post#cook returns raw unfiltered for that method, and embed/best.html.erb renders `<%= raw post.cooked %>`. No sanitization of feed content exists anywhere in the diff, so malicious feed HTML would be served unescaped — a real XSS/security defect introduced by this change.

records.issue_text: spec/controllers/embed_controller_spec.rb:42 — The test expects a direct TopicRetriever call although the controller enqueues retrieve_topic, so it fails and does not test the asynchronous behavior.
records.rationale: The controller code in the diff shows `Jobs.enqueue(:retrieve_topic, ...)` when no previous embed is found, but the new spec at embed_controller_spec.rb:42 mocks `TopicRetriever.expects(:new).returns(retriever); retriever.expects(:retrieve)` directly. Since enqueue only schedules the job (no inline execution shown in the diff), the expectation will never be satisfied and the test fails; it also doesn't exercise the async job's behavior. This is a verifiable defect in code added by this diff.
